ref-jet.prompt: Use case: character reference sheet. Image 1 is Pip, a small friendly dragon. Image 2 is the painted storybook style reference only. Paint Jet, Pip’s little cousin: the same young dragon species, body shape and size as Pip, but with bright red scales, a cream belly, small cream horns, big friendly amber eyes and large leaf-green wings opened a little. Cheerful, curious, slightly cheeky. One full-body figure standing on a plain warm cream background with a soft ground shadow, three-quarter view. Painterly children’s picture-book style matching image 2. No text, no other characters, no props.

ref-grandma.prompt: Use case: character reference sheet. Image 1 is Pip, a small friendly dragon. Image 2 is the painted storybook style reference only. Paint Grandma, an old grandmother dragon of the same friendly species: about twice Pip’s size, soft dusty rose-red scales fading to grey, a cream belly, kind wrinkled eyes behind small round spectacles, short curled grey horns, folded faded green wings, and a knitted honey-yellow shawl over her shoulders. Warm, gentle and a little worried. One full-body figure standing on a plain warm cream background with a soft ground shadow, three-quarter view. Painterly children’s picture-book style matching image 2. No text, no other characters.
